scope: Independent mathematical and primitive-ODE audit of Jin2025 SI S39-48 reduced two-mode photon model
source: 10.1038/s41565-025-02003-1 SI PDF pages24-28, plus Fig2 static linewidth source data
amplitude_rate_units: kappa=2*pi*GHz/1000 in ps^-1; photon number decay rate=2*kappa
symmetric_ports: single incident face sqrt(kappa1); both output faces 2*kappa2*abs(b2)^2; CW prefactor1/2
pulse_FWHM: tau is intensity FWHM; amplitude exp[-2ln2(t-center)^2/tau^2]
source_ambiguity: SI7 says absolute photon efficiency but does not specify its integration functional; a peak above1/2 is incompatible with total single-sided pulse conversion in its stated symmetric photon-conserving model, while spectral-density ratio may exceed1/2.

prior_delay_probe.note: Prior exploratory values use lower C than root C_low=.001; small delay and efficiency differences are intentional parameter differences, not solver error.

checks.method: Independent primitive real-envelope Radau, with integral states; no transient.py or Floquet calls

scope_limits: This is the explicit paper TCMT closure, not a Legume tensor/full-Maxwell certificate.
Actual asymmetric slab radiation branching and material absorption are not inferred from total linewidth.
Residual paper-curve differences are retained without refitting decay rates or rescaling efficiencies.
